stage: R2-1 RCLED 453 nm STACK/TMM high-Q cavity redesign screening

abbreviations.RCLED: Resonant-Cavity LED, 谐振腔发光二极管
abbreviations.DBR: Distributed Bragg Reflector, 分布式布拉格反射镜
abbreviations.FDTD: Finite-Difference Time-Domain, 时域有限差分法
abbreviations.TMM: Transfer Matrix Method, 传输矩阵法
abbreviations.STACK: multilayer stack optical solver, 多层膜堆光学求解器
abbreviations.FWHM: Full Width at Half Maximum, 半高全宽
abbreviations.APCD: Arbitrary Polarization Conversion Dichroism, 任意偏振转换二色性
abbreviations.MQW: Multiple Quantum Wells, 多量子阱
abbreviations.eta20_eta30: ±20°/±30° cone collection efficiency, ±20°/±30°锥角收集效率

pass_levels.Level A: spectral FWHM <=6 nm, angular FWHM <=10 deg, peak_abs<=5 deg, normal/offaxis>1.5
pass_levels.Level B: spectral FWHM <=8 nm, angular FWHM <=25 deg, peak_abs<=10 deg, normal/offaxis>1.0

method_note: Lightweight STACK/TMM-style proxy screen; no FDTD was run.
